assets.conformance_v1_4_0: receipt-structure conformance asset only; excluded from this pool (no parameter attack payloads); unrelated to interception rate

schema_snapshot.contains: tool name, parameter name/description/classes, G-G labels (STATIC SCHEMA ONLY)
schema_snapshot.excludes: no payload run-values, no attack loads

citation_rule: Only the 600-vector pool (dev+holdout) may back external/paper/standard metrics; the 16-vector smoke split is CI-only and never externally cited.
limitations: Vectors instantiate the G-G parameter-risk paradigm via deterministic family x variant templates. They do NOT cover unknown, out-of-distribution escape forms. Benign values are realistic synthetic values placed on real 229k-snapshot parameters (raw schemas are not available locally). Whole-value obfuscation vectors are expected FN's on the current engine and measure a future normalization tier. Not a benchmark claim until a third-party runner evaluates this frozen pool.

lock_policy.holdout: sealed; dev iteration MUST NOT read holdout or tune against it; exactly ONE evaluation after rule freeze, via the gated harness (run ledger)
lock_policy.smoke: 16 legacy literals; CI regression on every commit; not citable as an evaluation result

splits.holdout_note: A 200-vector sealed holdout split exists for a single no-tuning confirmation but is intentionally NOT published and is absent from this repository.

pool_construction.note: The 600-vector frozen pool = 400 published dev + 200 sealed holdout. The 16 smoke vectors are a separate CI sanity set, not part of the frozen baseline.
